about: Official registry of every game in the feed. Numbers are permanent: never renumber or reuse one. 'planned' holds games that are designed but not built yet (their spec is in specs/). The feed app and LEDGER.md are generated from this file. A game is on the phone app only when its 'in_app' is true, and that is set only when Nabeel says to put it on the app; until then it is just a page for him to play-test. 'core': true marks the core games (the first six): they are inside the phone app itself and always on the phone. Every other game on the app is played over the internet, and he can save one from the Games list to keep it on the phone.

feed_app.name: Game Feed
feed_app.summary: All the games in one scrolling app: a shuffled feed of game cards (a short silent clip of each), tap to play at the level he was on, swipe for the next, search and pin; Pause on the bar, and Resume, Restart and Levels on every paused game. Built from this registry by tools/build_feed.py; the same build is the hosted page, the inside of the Android app, and the 'app-v2' branch that installed apps fetch new games from, so a phone gets every new game by itself. Changes to the feed page or the Android wrapper reach him only in a new GameFeed.apk. The core games (the first six) are inside the app and always on the phone; every other game is fetched when its card comes up, and Save in the Games list keeps one on the phone so it plays with no internet.
feed_app.published_frozen: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nabeel1305/game-feed/app/ (build 18, read by the first installed apps; never push to it or delete it)

games.name: Bottle Cap Flick
games.summary: Flick bottle caps to knock the other side's caps off a wooden stool. Capture line, legs at each end, a ladder of four computer levels from Beginner to Legendary (beat one to open the next), best of 1/3/5/7.
games.source: games/bottle-cap-flick/src (engine.js + game.tpl.html -> build.py; train.js = self-play tests)

feed.hook: Flick your caps across the stool. Knock theirs off.

games.name: Knockout
games.summary: First-person two-thumb boxing. Tap to punch, flick to dodge, flick up for an uppercut, hold both to block. Endless levels, rounds and points decisions.

feed.hook: First-person boxing. Jab, slip, block, put him down.

principles: P8 camera kick + bruises that stay
P18 combo chain with rising notes
P12 KO celebration (flash bulbs, bell, slow-mo)
P17 rare cat on the apron

games.name: High Noon
games.summary: Cowboy quick-draw duel. Thumb on the holster, wait for DRAW (watch for fake calls), slide up to aim, release to shoot. Headshots win; endless levels.

feed.hook: Hand on the holster. Wait for the call, then draw.

principles: P7 freeze on the winning shot
P11 haptic tick on the count and DRAW

games.name: Steel & Honour
games.summary: First-person medieval sword duels. Your blade follows your finger in any direction; tap to poke an exact spot. His cuts come from any angle and his thrusts aim at a spot: block by swiping across his blade on the side it comes from (or through the spot of a thrust). Perfect parries open him up. Endless levels, rounds, champion knights, huge variety of knights.

feed.hook: Sword duels where the blade follows your finger.

principles: P18 parry chain with rising steel
P7 hit-stop on parries and the winning blow
P8 dents and scratches that stay

games.name: Zenith
games.summary: Superhero rescue patrols over Brightwater City. Alert after alert: fly through gold rings, then catch falling people, zap meteors with laser eyes, punch bad guys, blow out fires, lift hanging buses, and dodge-and-zap giant monsters and super villains. Missions are mixed from long lists so they rarely repeat.

feed.hook: One hero, a city of emergencies. Catch, zap, lift, fight.

principles: P18 rising chimes for rings and catches
P26 variety: never the same mission twice in a row
P13 best saves-in-a-row + lifetime citizens helped
P12 SAVED! stamp, bigger for monsters/villains

games.name: Hippodrome
games.summary: Greek four-horse chariot racing seen from behind your own chariot. Two thumbs: left steers the reins, right taps the whip on the beat of the gallop or holds to rein in. Turning the post is the skill: rein in, hug the inside, whip out, and pass rivals by turning tighter than they do. Ram a rival who is level with you by swerving into them, dodge when a rough rival winds up to ram you, and break a chariot to put it out of the race; damage shows on the chariot. Live leaderboard, 4 to 8 chariots with Greek names, 12 venues from Olympia to Troy, a champion of legend every 10th race, endless levels.

feed.hook: Four horses, one wreath. Whip on the beat, ram your rivals.

principles: P18 chains: perfect whip cracks climb in pitch; perfect turns chain
P4 readable failure: painted braking zone, slide dust and lean, WHEEL UP warning, flashing wind bar, a clear warning before every ram
P3 honest near-miss: real finishing gaps, real turn times, real clearance from the post, the true cost of every blow
P12 celebrations scaled: overtake call, perfect turn, a rival broken, the wreath
P13 personal bests: race time and best lap per level, longest whip chain

games.name: Bandit
games.summary: A one-on-one fighter-jet dogfight above the clouds, seen from just behind your own jet. Two thumbs: the left flies (push it where the nose should go; hard turns cost speed), the right fires and drops flares. Get behind the bandit and hold him in your ring to lock on, then fire a missile; up close, hold FIRE for the cannon. He weaves, drops flares, then hauls round and comes for you: a mirror shows him on your tail, and when his missile is in the air you turn hard and tap FLARE as the ring closes on the button. Bandits with their own call signs, jets and paint, an ace every 10th sortie, one to three bandits a sortie, stars for taking no hits, endless levels.

feed.hook: One bandit on your tail. Break, flare, turn the tables.

principles: P4 readable failure: lock warning with a mirror and a bar, MISSILE! call, the ring that closes on FLARE, and TOO EARLY / TOO LATE / TURN HARDER after a wasted flare
P5 teach by doing: sortie 1 he only flies, sortie 2 he starts behind you for the flare lesson, sortie 3 he flares; one coach line at a time
P7 hit-stop and slow motion on a kill; P8 shake and smoke that stays on a damaged jet
P3 honest near-miss: on a loss, how much of his jet was left and what your last flare did wrong
P13 personal bests: fastest sortie per level, longest run of sorties won
P2 disclosed help after three losses: he locks slower and his missiles fly slower; the rules stay the same

games.name: Plunder
games.summary: A pirate game in two halves. You set sail on an expedition and steer your sloop from above until the lookout sights a ship or a fleet of up to three, merchant, navy or both: the card shows the loot and the danger, and you raid or sail on. Navy ships must be beaten with cannons first: their guns only reach out of their sides (shown in red before they fire); yours fire from the wheel when a ship is in your gold arc (going round and round hard over spoils the aim), ROW gives a short burst of speed until the crew tire, and a quick sloop can sit on a heavy ship's bow or stern. Then you come alongside and board (the first three boardings teach every move, slowly, and the fight starts only once you can do each one two or three times): first person, on deck, below deck and in the captain's cabin. Block his blow with one swipe across his blade, on the side it comes from, and strike while he is open; or attack first, hammering his sword until his guard breaks (but just after, he is set, and a blow then is turned and punished); pull down to dodge; one pistol ball at a time, slow to reload, three in all, and you drag the sights onto him. One bar is the tide of the fight: fight well and your crew takes the ship, fight badly and they break. Spamming cannot win, at sea or on deck, on any expedition: no repeated pattern of moves does, at any speed. The win screen counts out the loot. Calm shanty while cruising, fast with a drum once a sail is sighted. Expeditions get harder for ever; a treasure fleet every 10th; stars, best haul and pirate rank.

feed.hook: Sight a sail. Beat her guns. Board her and take the gold.

principles: P4 fair readable failure: her gun ports open and the red fan fills before she fires; every blow shows its path (white, then gold when a block will count); after a wound it says why (TOO EARLY, MISSED THE BLOCK, CAUGHT SWINGING)
P7 hit-stop: a heartbeat of stillness on a clean block, a riposte, the pistol, a broadside striking home
P12 celebration scaled: a man down, a deck taken, the captain yielding, then the loot counted out line by line with rising coins
P14 goal-gradient: one bar for the tide of the fight, three parts of the ship, four pips for the expedition
P18 chains: clean blocks in a row ring higher and sharpen the riposte; best run is kept

games.name: Reel

feed.hook: Wait for the float to go under. Then hold on.

games.summary: A fishing game in 3D, seen from the end of a wooden jetty on a mountain lake, with the weather and light changing by level (dawn, rain, mist, storm, sunset, night with a glowing float). Pull your thumb down and let go to cast to where fish are rising; leave the little nibbles and flick up to strike when the float is pulled right under (too soon scares them, too late loses the bait). Then fight it home: hold to reel, let go when it thrashes and runs or the line snaps, and drag against its way to turn it from the reeds and lily pads. Land the fish asked for before the light goes; three lines. The first three levels teach every move. Six kinds of fish plus rare golden carp and a named giant every tenth level; your biggest of each kind is kept.

games.name: Wild Water

feed.hook: Two thumbs, two paddles. Find the line through the rocks.

games.summary: A whitewater kayak game in 3D, seen from the cockpit with the bow in front and the paddle in your gloves. Your two thumbs are the two blades: swipe down on the left for a left stroke (it swings the bow right), on the right for a right stroke; swipe up to back-paddle. The current carries you down a winding river through rows of rocks with one gap each, past fallen trees on the outside of the bends, over ledges you must take straight through the smooth tongue, and between slalom gates for stars. Three smashes or rolls and the boat is done. Weather and light change by run. The first three runs teach every stroke.

games.name: Soar

feed.hook: Fly over the sea and the mountains, through the golden rings.

games.summary: The calm one: a 3D flight over a sea of islands, seen from just over your shoulder, arms forward and a scarf streaming, under a real sky that changes by flight (golden hour, dawn, mist, sunset, night with stars). One thumb steers like a little stick wherever you put it down: right to lean and turn, up to climb, down to dive. Follow a trail of golden rings; each ring is a bell note that climbs the scale while the chain lasts. Nothing hurts you: touch the sea or a hillside and you skim off it. Fly through enough rings to finish the flight; all of them for three stars.

games.name: Vine

feed.hook: Let go at the top of the swing. Catch the next vine.

games.summary: Swing through a 3D rainforest gorge on vines, a river far below, light falling through mist, weather by canopy. Your thumb is your grip: keep it down to hold the vine and swing, lift it to let go as you swing forward and up (each vine needs its own moment), lean in the air by moving the thumb, and put it down to catch the next vine when your hand reaches it. Grab at air and the hand needs a moment; fall and you are back on the last vine, one of three lives. Reach the tree house before the light goes. The first three canopies teach every move.

games.name: Hunter

feed.hook: Creep through the grass. Freeze when it looks. Then throw.

games.summary: The intense one: an ice-age hunt in 3D, first person, crouched in tall grass on a steppe under snowy mountains, weather by hunt. Left thumb held creeps forward; lift it to freeze when the animal flicks its ears and looks up, or it sees you and bolts. Right thumb pulls back and lets go to throw a flint spear where the mark on the ground is: the chest brings it down, a haunch only wounds it, and far throws fall short. Sometimes a cave lion growls from one side: swipe toward it and tap the instant it leaps to brace your spear. Deer, horses, boar, bison, and a woolly mammoth every tenth hunt. A heartbeat that quickens as you close in.

games.name: Police Chase

feed.hook: Lights on. Ram him off the road, then run him down.

games.summary: A three-part police chase in 3D through a city at night. Pursuit: hold the left or right side of the screen to steer your patrol car (both to brake) through traffic, and ram the getaway car's back corner from the side to spin him out. On foot: chase him down a brick alley, swiping round crates, over fences and under pipes, and tap to tackle when you are right behind him. Arrest: when he twists one way, swipe the other way to hold him until the cuffs are on. Lights, siren, rain on the tarmac; weather changes by case.

games.name: Pilot

feed.hook: Bring her down gently. Flare at the last moment.

games.summary: Land an airliner in 3D at a countryside airport, seen from just behind the plane, in weather that changes by flight (fog, rain, storm, sunset, night with the runway lights). Right thumb is the control column: left and right to bank, pull back to raise the nose; left thumb is the throttle. Follow the glide-path lights (two white, two red), keep on the centre line in a crosswind, hold the speed, then flare just before the wheels touch for a soft landing. The first three flights teach it a piece at a time.

games.name: Short Order

feed.hook: Golden, not burnt. Get the orders out.

games.summary: Run the grill of a small 3D diner kitchen, seen from where the cook stands, with the street's weather and light in the window. Drag food from the trays onto the pans, the board or the plate; tap a pan to flip when the ring turns golden; sweep across the board to chop; drag the plate up to the pass. Pancakes, eggs on toast, burgers, salmon salad, steak and onions: golden, not burnt, before the customer walks out. The first three levels teach it a piece at a time.

games.name: Country Vet

feed.hook: Calm them, find what hurts, make it better.

games.summary: Be the vet in an old 3D barn, the farmyard's weather and light through the open door. Dogs, cows, sheep, horses, pigs and goats come in with a thorn, an overgrown hoof, a cut, a fever, caked mud or a sore ear. Read the owner's card, look at her to see where, pick the right tool and use it the way it is really used: pull a thorn out slowly, rasp a hoof to the line, spray and wrap a cut, hold the needle in and lift off when she shivers, brush with the hair, drop into a still ear. Rough handling frightens her: stroke her slowly to calm her. The first three levels teach every tool.

games.name: Lighthouse

feed.hook: Light the way home. Lead each lost boat past the rocks.

games.summary: Keep a lighthouse on a wild night, in 3D, from the gallery at the top: a dark moving sea, rain and lightning or stars and a moon. Lost fishing boats drift towards the rocks. Your thumb is the lamp: hold the beam on a boat until its lamp blinks back, then lead it slowly, round rocks that only show in your light, to the harbour's red and green lights. Several boats can follow the one light. The first three levels teach it.

games.name: Hiring

feed.hook: Read the CV. Find the job it fits. Or the bin.

games.summary: Run the hiring desk of a busy town agency, flat 2D on a wooden desk so the papers read well. Three open jobs are pinned at the top with what each needs; CVs come one at a time (photo, age, where they live, experience, certificates with their dates, licence and points, languages, when they can work). Drag each onto the job it fits, or into the bin. Near misses grow: a year short, a certificate that ran out last month. Two wrong calls end the day. The first three levels teach it.

games.name: Potter's Wheel

feed.hook: Shape the spinning clay to match the order.

games.summary: Throw pots on a wheel in a 3D workshop, the yard's weather and light in the window and your fired pots on the shelves. A lump of wet clay spins; the order's outline is dotted on both sides. Touch the side of the clay and move slowly: it follows your fingertip in or out. Too quick and it wobbles and can collapse. Tap FIRE when the match passes the mark. Later the clay dries. The first three levels teach it.

games.name: Drone Pilot

feed.hook: Two sticks, like a real drone. Thread every hoop.

games.summary: Fly a racing drone through a course of glowing hoops in a 3D park (hills, trees, buildings, weather and wind by level), seen from just behind. Two sticks, like a real controller: left thumb climbs and turns, right thumb flies forwards and slides. The drone drifts and the wind pushes it; each hoop gives back seconds; clip a rim or a tree and it crashes. The first three levels teach it.

games.name: Whaling

feed.hook: Row to the spout. Throw. Then hold on.

games.summary: Hunt whales the old way from a wooden whaleboat on a grey 3D sea. Left thumb steers while the crew rows to her spout; swipe up with the right thumb to throw the harpoon while her back is up (lead her). Then hold on: hold to haul the line and tire her, let go when her flukes rise before a run or the line snaps, keep the bow pointing at her or the boat heels over. The first three levels teach it.

games.name: Wolf Pack

feed.hook: Run it down with your pack. Strike from the side.

games.summary: Run as the lead wolf of a small pack across open 3D snow between dark pines (golden dusk, grey morning, falling snow, night). One elk in the fleeing herd is marked. Slide your thumb to steer, push it up for a burst (it tires you), tap FLANK to send a packmate up one side so she swerves towards you, and flick towards her to strike when you are close and beside her; from straight behind she kicks. Reach her before the trees. The first three levels teach it.

games.name: On the Run

feed.hook: Swipe to dodge, tap for nitro. Get to the safehouse.

games.summary: Getaway in three phases: weave the night avenue, dodge rams and roadblocks with swipes and nitro, then run the alleys on foot to the safehouse; a garage of upgrades and a rank that stay.

games.name: Castle Siege

feed.hook: Build towers, upgrade them, hold the gate.

games.summary: Tower defence in a 3D valley, all taps: build archers, catapults, mages and frost by the road, upgrade them, drop meteors; eight roads, ten kinds of foe and a boss every tenth siege; royal upgrades and rank that stay.

games.name: Tag

feed.hook: Chase, flee, freeze: the playground's fastest kid.

games.summary: Playground tag in 3D with a floating stick and a double-tap dash: chase, run, freeze tag, zombie tag and the big kid, with power-ups, places, a tuck shop of upgrades and a rank that stay.

games.name: Heaven or Hell

feed.hook: Weigh their deeds. Up to Heaven, down to Hell.

games.summary: Keep the gate: weigh each soul's best and worst deed, unseal hidden deeds in the Book of Life, mind the day's rule and the liars, and drag them up, down or to Purgatory; blessings and rank that stay.

games.name: Harvest Valley

feed.hook: Plant, water, harvest: fill the orders by sunset.

games.summary: A farm by the day in 3D, all taps: plant, water when a crop asks, pick when it sparkles, collect eggs, shoo crows and fill the cart's orders by sunset; seasons and rain; farm upgrades and rank that stay.

games.name: Horde

feed.hook: Monsters from every side. Move, level up, survive.

games.summary: Survive the night horde with one thumb: weapons fire by themselves, you pick an upgrade at every level-up, light three beacons to call the boss and beat it.

games.name: Mini Golf

feed.hook: Pull back, let go. Windmills, ramps and water.

games.summary: Calm 3D mini golf: pull back and let go to putt around windmills, bumpers, slopes and water, under par to win, with a shop and ranks.

games.name: Penalty Kings

feed.hook: Pick your corner. Read the kicker. Win the cup.

games.summary: A cup run of penalty shootouts in a floodlit stadium: tap where to shoot and stop the needle in the green; read the kicker's body when he plants his foot and dive the right way.

games.name: Critter Clash

feed.hook: Fire beats leaf. Time your hit. Catch them all.

games.summary: Turn-by-turn battles between teams of bouncing critters: fire beats leaf, time the ring for a critical, guard the big attacks, and catch wild critters for your collection.

games.name: Rodeo

feed.hook: Eight seconds. One angry bull. Lean against every buck.

games.summary: Eight seconds on a bucking bull with two thumbs: hold left or right to lean, read his head to lean against each buck before it lands, grip the spins, and score with the judges.

games.name: Eleven

feed.hook: Turn your phone sideways. Eleven a side. Beat every team.

games.summary: A full eleven-a-side football match played sideways: run with the left thumb, PASS, SHOOT and LOB; beat a team and the next one is better.

games.name: Deep Bite

feed.hook: Eat the small ones. Flee the big ones. Grow.

games.summary: His shark idea in 3D: drag to swim, eat the fish smaller than you, run from the hunters, grow until what chased you becomes lunch; a golden fish beside a hunter, an aquarium of every kind you find.

games.name: Powder

feed.hook: Carve the mountain. Beat your own ghost.

games.summary: Snowboard down a 3D mountain against the clock: hold and slide to carve through the gates, tap to jump rocks, spin off kickers and land straight; your best run rides beside you as a ghost; boards to open.

games.name: Cairn

feed.hook: Stack river stones by the lake. How high can it stand?

games.summary: The calm one: stack river stones on a boulder by a misty 3D lake; tap to drop the swaying stone, pick slabs or round stones from the basket, three perfect drops find a stone; your finished cairns stay in the shallows.

games.name: Pinball

feed.hook: Two thumbs, two flippers. Light the whole table.

games.summary: A real 3D pinball table: hold the left or right half for each flipper, catch and aim, finish the missions on the backbox (the ramp, the drop targets, the orbit) before the balls are gone; multiplier, extra ball, multiball, trophies.

games.name: Drumline

feed.hook: Two drums, one beat. Keep the crowd on its feet.

games.summary: A rhythm game in a 3D stadium at halftime: notes roll down two lanes to a snare and a tom, tap left and right on the beat, gold notes for both, drum rolls; the crowd meter, FEVER, a new song every level.

games.name: Strike Alley

feed.hook: Line it up, let it roll, hear the pins fly.

games.summary: Bowling in a neon alley: touch to line up, pull back and let go; a dotted line shows the curl; spares, strike-outs, balls to collect.

games.name: Bonsai

feed.hook: Grow a little tree through the seasons and shape it.

games.summary: Grow a little tree through the seasons into the festival's outline: tap buds to grow, tap branches to prune, flick caterpillars.

games.name: Star Miner

feed.hook: Fly a little mining ship: crack asteroids, scoop ore, dodge pirates.

games.summary: Fly a little mining ship with one floating stick: the laser cracks rocks by itself, scoop the ore, carry it home before the mothership jumps; meteors and pirates.

games.name: Ghost Lantern

feed.hook: Walk a haunted house: hold a ghost in your lantern's beam to catch it.

games.summary: Walk a haunted house with one floating stick: hold ghosts in your lantern's beam to catch them, turn to the frost of one behind you, keep the oil burning.

games.name: Drift Kings

feed.hook: Kart racing: hold a hard turn to drift, let go to boost; tap for your item.

games.summary: Kart racing with two thumbs: slide the left to steer, hold a hard turn to drift and charge a boost, tap the right for your item; a cup of four tracks.

games.name: The Bench

feed.hook: You are the judge: read each case and write your own sentence.

games.summary: You are the judge: read the case, write your own sentence in plain words; the clerk (an AI) reads it back; a council of three marks every five, or switch it off and sentence freely. PG or 18+.

games.name: Haggle

feed.hook: Run a pawn shop: inspect what they bring, haggle the price down, spot the fakes.

games.summary: A pawn shop: sellers bring things in, you turn a brass dial to make offers, check for fakes, and learn what things are worth over the days; beat the day's profit target.

games.name: Battle Lines

feed.hook: Be the general: pick your formation, then tap a unit and tap where it charges.

games.summary: A general above the field: pick a formation, swap units, sound BATTLE, then tap a unit and tap where it goes or whom it hits; spears stop horses, flanks break lines, and men you send in yourself fight twice as hard.

games.name: Grand Hotel

feed.hook: Run the hotel: bags, room service, clean rooms, tips

games.summary: The hotel's only attendant: bubbles pop up over rooms and the desk (bags, room service, towels, dirty rooms); tap to take a job, hold three, fetch two plates in one trip, keep your promises and the stars.

games.name: Ramp Riders

feed.hook: Two thumbs, one bike: flip it and stick the landing

games.summary: A trials bike side-on: two thumbs lean it back and forward; off the kickers turn it to the slope you will land on, flip it for a boost, beat the time and your own ghost.

games.name: Spellshop

feed.hook: Be the town magician: read their story, brew the cure

games.summary: The town magician: read the customer's story for clues, pick the jars (each always means one thing), pour, stir in or out, trace the rune, seal; funny mistakes come back to be fixed, bad ones complain.

games.name: Rex

feed.hook: Be the T-Rex: hunt the herds, beat the rivals

games.summary: Be the T-Rex in a 3D valley: one stick to creep or charge, BITE and ROAR; runners, duckbill herds, armoured spikebacks, charging hornfaces and rival rexes, each warning before it strikes.

games.name: High Wire

feed.hook: Walk the high wire: lean, steady, step

games.summary: Walk a high wire in 3D with one floating stick: slide to swing the pole, push up to walk, pull down to crouch; wind, birds, banners and sandbags; last-second saves; lean out for stars.

games.name: Homemaker

feed.hook: Build a house, room by room, then walk through it

games.summary: Build houses on a 3D plot, a shed first and whole homes later: pick a piece, tap or drag (walls snap), windows, doors, furniture, one-tap roof; tick the checklist, move in and walk through. Every house is kept.

games.name: Fruit Fight

feed.hook: Slingshot fruit at the monsters before they reach you

games.summary: First-person slingshot in a 3D meadow: pull back and let go with an arc to aim; oranges are quick, watermelons burst on crowds, bananas trip; blobs, scuttlers, shield-trolls, hoppers and big ones with a glowing eye.

games.name: Tri-Peaks

feed.hook: Clear three peaks of cards, one higher or lower

games.summary: Calm cards: clear three peaks by playing one higher or lower onto the pile; streaks earn jokers, locks need the key card, the stock is short.

games.name: Oarsmen

feed.hook: Two thumbs, two oars: row in rhythm, win the race

games.summary: Rowing race down a river in 3D: left thumb left oar, right thumb right oar, stroke on the green together to build rhythm, one oar to steer round bends, rocks and logs; beat the rival boats.

games.name: Safecracker

feed.hook: Turn the dial, feel the click, open the safe before the guard comes back.

games.summary: Crack a safe by feel: drag round the dial slowly, feel the click, turn back to the chalk mark and SET; too fast is noisy, wrong numbers raise the alarm, keep still in the guard's torchlight, open it before dawn.

games.name: Fire Crew

feed.hook: Hold to spray, tap to send the ladder: beat the fire before the smoke wins.

games.summary: A building on fire in 3D: hold one thumb to spray the hose just above it, lift to let the tank refill, tap people once their window is clear to send the ladder; gas bottles, backdraft and wind.

games.name: Origami

feed.hook: Drag a corner, crease, and a paper fox comes to life.

games.summary: Fold paper animals: drag a corner and the paper folds after your thumb; let go when it fits the dashed outline. Perfect folds, crumples, six animals that come to life on your shelf.

games.name: Sugar Swap

feed.hook: Swipe sweets into lines of three. Make stripes, wraps and bombs.

games.summary: Match-3 like Candy Crush: swipe sweets into lines; striped, wrapped and colour-bomb specials and their combos; goals (collect, jelly, cherries, frosting, score) with a move limit; the Sugar Rush.

games.name: Black Keys

feed.hook: Tap the black tiles and play the song. Never touch the white.

games.summary: Piano Tiles style: tap the black tiles, never the white; each tile plays the next note of a real piece (16 public-domain songs); long tiles to hold, double rows for two thumbs, speeds up, an encore.

games.name: Paint Drop

feed.hook: Drop paint blobs. Same colours squash into bigger ones. Don't overflow.

games.summary: Drop-and-merge like the watermelon game, with paint: same colours squash into the next colour; wet paint squashes, dry does not; a palette that dries without squashes; the colour chart up to the goal; don't overflow.

games.name: Pour

feed.hook: Tap a glass, tap another, pour. Sort every colour into its own glass.

games.summary: Colour sort like Water Sort: tap a glass, tap another, pour; sort every colour into its own glass; solver-made puzzles with a move margin, undo, hidden layers, a mark on every colour.

games.name: Block Party

feed.hook: Drag blocks onto the grid. Fill a row or column and it clears.

games.summary: Block puzzle like Block Blast: drag pieces from a tray of three onto an 8x8 grid; full rows and columns clear; combos multiply; gem and score goals; junk and bigger pieces as levels rise.

games.name: Plumber

feed.hook: House calls: leaks, clogs, no water, burst pipes. Find the fault, fix it, get paid.

games.summary: His idea: a plumber's day of house calls. Pick calls from the phone, drive there, look at parts of the cut-open house to find the real fault, pick the fix and do it by hand (hold a wrench into the green, plunge on the beat, feed a snake, set a dial, fit a part); floods until the main is shut; 21 kinds of job.

games.name: Stunt Kart

feed.hook: Kart racing with ramps: tap in the air to flip and spin, land it for a boost, fill your STAR.

games.summary: His idea, Mario Kart with cool things: kart racing in 3D with ramps (tap in the air for flips, spins and rolls; land between them for a boost, mid-trick is a wipeout), a gold glider jump through air coins, boost pads, coins, items and a STAR you fill with tricks.

games.name: Knife Spin

feed.hook: Tap to throw knives into the spinning log. Hit another knife and you're out.

games.summary: Like Knife Hit: tap to throw knives into a spinning target that speeds up, stops and turns back; hit a knife already in and you're out; apples on the rim; the target bursts when full; three targets a level and a boss every fifth.

games.name: Mow It

feed.hook: Mow the lawn into perfect stripes. Mind the flowers, empty the bag, watch the fuel.

games.summary: The calm one: mow a garden from above into light and dark stripes with a floating thumb; cut the share needed before the fuel runs out, steer round flower beds, empty the grass box at the bin; coins and a treasure in the long grass.

games.name: Helix Drop

feed.hook: Turn the tower so the ball drops through the gaps. Red means stop. Fall fast and smash through.

games.summary: Turn the tower with your thumb so the ball drops through the gaps; red ends it; three drops in a row and the ball catches fire and smashes the next platform.

games.name: Sinkhole

feed.hook: You are a hole in the road. Swallow the town.

games.summary: You are a hole in the road: slide to swallow everything smaller than you, grow until houses and towers fall in, fill the town meter before the clock; red barrels blow up, other holes race you.

games.name: Crowd Run

feed.hook: Grow your crowd through the gates and beat the giant.

games.summary: Steer a crowd of runners through gates that add, multiply, subtract and divide, past saws, hammers and walls, over narrow bridges and through red crowds, then beat the giant and climb the bonus stairs.

games.name: Word Wheel

feed.hook: Slide through the letters to fill the crossword.

games.summary: A calm word game: slide your thumb through a wheel of letters to spell the words that fill a little crossword; any other real word is a bonus; made-up words spill ink.

games.name: Sharpshooter

feed.hook: Find the thief in the crowd and put him to sleep.

games.summary: From a rooftop, find the thief in a busy square by the clues on the card, then put him to sleep with a dart: hold FIRE for the scope and your breath, lead him, mind the wind, never hit a passer-by.

games.name: Beat Dash

feed.hook: Jump to the beat. One tap. Don't touch the spikes.

games.summary: A cube runs to the beat: tap to jump, hold to keep jumping; spikes, blocks, pits, pads, rings and gravity portals sit on the beat; three lives and flags; reach 100%.

games.name: Shadow Crew

feed.hook: You are the traitor on the station. Don't get caught.

games.summary: You are the hidden traitor on a 3D space station of hand-drawn sticker crewmates: knock them out when no one can see, vanish through vents, sabotage, and talk your way out of meetings. New rules every few levels.

games.name: Kart Kingdom

feed.hook: Steer, drift, NITRO! 16 tracks, shells, gliders. Win the cup.

games.summary: His idea, a kart racer like Super Mario Kart (all our own): 16 courses in 4 cups (then 100cc, 150cc, mirror, 200cc), 10 drivers led by Tobi the turtle, turtle shells and 10 other items, KartRider-style buttons (steer arrows, DRIFT, ITEM, NITRO), drifts with coloured sparks that fill the nitro, bananas thrown far ahead or behind, tricks off every jump, gliders through gold rings over chasms, rocket starts, course dangers, cup points and trophies.

games.name: Sprint

feed.hook: Tap left, right, left, right in time. Win the final.

games.summary: His idea: a sprint where your two thumbs are your two feet. Tap the side whose ring is closing, as it closes: on the beat drives you on and builds FLOW, mashing trips you. A real start (reaction time, false starts, out on the second), hurdles and the dip with both thumbs, five events (60 m, 100 m, 60 m and 110 m hurdles, 200 m round the bend) in heats, semis and finals at six 3D stadiums, the ghost of your best run, kit colours, upgrades and ranks.

games.name: Bus Driver

feed.hook: Pick them up, stop on the mark, keep to time.

games.summary: His idea: drive a city bus along its route through a 3D town with two pedals (hold GO, hold BRAKE; both ease in). Stop with the front door on the stop's mark and the doors open by themselves; people step off and climb aboard; leave on the stop's time, never before it. Red lights, zebra crossings with people, the car in front, speed cameras, corners to slow for, and a cup of tea that spills if you drive roughly. Six districts, rush hours, liveries, upgrades and ranks.

games.name: Cake Designer

feed.hook: Stack it, ice it, pipe it, top it. Make their dream cake.

games.summary: His idea: a calm 3D bakery. A customer orders a cake (tiers, icing colour, drip, swirls, toppings) and you make it in five stages, each with its own control: STACK (tap to set each gliding tier down), COLOUR (tap the icing on the card), ICE (the cake spins; hold your thumb on it and the knife spreads icing there), PIPE (tap as each dot passes under the bag), TOP (tap to place berries, candles, cherries, macarons). The customer scores each part; great cakes tip. Six bakeries, show cakes, stands, upgrades and ranks.

games.name: Paint It

feed.hook: Roll it, brush it, stay in the lines. So satisfying.

games.summary: His idea: a calm 3D painting game with lovely sounds. Paint real things (a fence, a door, a beach hut, a shed wall with a heart, a birdhouse, a car, a boat, a mural) by dragging your thumb over them: paint goes on under it. A wide ROLLER and a fine BRUSH, pots to change colour, a faint pattern of which colour goes where, glass and edges to keep clean, and blue tape that is safe to paint over and peels off at the end for crisp lines.

games.name: Kite Fighter

feed.hook: Hold to pull, let go to turn. Cross their line and CUT IT!

games.summary: My idea for set 14: rooftop kite fighting (Basant, Uttarayan, pipa combate) in 3D. One thumb: hold to pull (the kite darts the way its nose points), let go to give slack (it turns on the spot). Cross a rival's line and the lines saw: the one pulling while its kite moves cuts the other, and the kite above, diving across, has the edge (BO KATA!). Cut the kites the round asks for before the daylight goes; catch falling kites; doubles and triples; six skies including a night festival with lanterns; kites, upgrades (sharp manja, strong line, light kite, big spool) and ranks.

games.name: Dress Designer

feed.hook: Design the dress, walk the runway, win the judges.

games.summary: A client brings a brief; design the dress part by part on a turning model (cut, length, sleeves, fabric, colour, pattern, finishing touches placed on the dress), then she walks the runway and three judges give stars, saying exactly what missed.

games.name: Taxi Driver

feed.hook: Pick them up, find the way, beat the meter.

games.summary: The cab drives itself: hold to brake, swipe to change lane, swipe in the glowing turn zone to turn. Pick up whoever waves, find the way (GPS or round the jams), stop at their door before the meter runs out; rushers, nervous passengers and tourists each want a different drive.

games.name: Roach Run

feed.hook: Sneak out, grab the crumbs, dodge the slipper.

games.summary: His idea 12: a cockroach leaves its crack in the wall at night, runs through a huge 3D house for crumbs and big pieces and carries them home before dawn, dodging slippers (a growing shadow aimed where it is heading) and bug spray (the can comes down first, the cloud lingers). Floating stick, SPRINT with stamina, HIDE near hiding places, DROP to escape.

games.name: Hoop Shot

feed.hook: Pull back, let go, swish.

games.summary: His idea 13: basketball purely shooting. Pull back from anywhere for power, sideways to aim, let go; the path's dots show early on; misses say too strong, too weak, left or right; swishes, streaks and the crowd. Four courts; every fifth level a challenge (bank shots, a moving spot, around the world); Practice with unlimited balls.

games.name: Sheepdog

feed.hook: Be the dog. Get the flock in before dark.

games.summary: Mine: you are the sheepdog. Hold on the field and she runs there, let go and she lies down, tap to bark. Sheep are pushed, not commanded: they flow away from her, keep together and scatter if rushed. Gather strays, drive the flock round trees and over the bridge into the pen before sunset; lambs, a stubborn ram, and a fox at dusk.

games.name: Sumo

feed.hook: Grip, push, pull: out of the ring!

games.summary: His idea 21: you are a huge sumo wrestler. A floating stick (up = into him) and three big buttons: PUSH (tap a shove, hold a big push), GRIP (hold his belt: drive, pull, turn), DODGE. Lean, stamina and the opening charge matter: pull or sidestep a man who lunges, turn him at the edge. Seven rivals (chargers, anchors, pullers), tournaments every fifth level, technique names in slow motion.

games.name: Memory Lane

feed.hook: Look closely… now what was there?

games.summary: His idea 23: look at a little scene, it is covered, then answer: which were there, put them back (drag), the order they lit up (each with its note), what is missing, what changed. Five rounds a level, 80% passes; your answer beside the scene with the differences ringed. More things, look-alikes and a shorter look, one at a time; a longer look and a Timed mode on the home screen.

games.name: Spy

feed.hook: Get in. Photograph the file. Get out.

games.summary: His idea 18: get into the building from the van, photograph the secret file and get out unseen. A floating stick (push far to run), CROUCH and one ACTION button that says what it does (open, hide, photograph, take, throw a coin). Guards' sight shown as torch fans cut by walls; a glimpse makes them look, then come, then run. Keycards, cameras, files on one of several desks as you go.

games.name: Mocktail Bar

feed.hook: Mix it right: they'll tell you if you didn't.

games.summary: A mocktail bar: read the order (or a feeling), pick the glass, pour to the parts, muddle, shake, stir or layer, garnish and serve; the customer's face and words say what was right or wrong.

games.name: Timber

feed.hook: Drop the tree exactly where you mean to.

games.summary: Fell trees into the open strip: drag to aim, hold NOTCH, hold SAW and let go to leave the hinge, tap WEDGE; lean, gusts, hikers and cabins decide where it may go.

games.name: Ice Hockey

feed.hook: Three on three on the ice: pass, shoot, score.

games.summary: Three-on-three ice hockey, played sideways: skate with the stick, pass, tap or hold to shoot, one-timers; on defence switch and poke. Two-minute matches or first to three.

games.name: Tennis

feed.hook: Swipe to swing: pull them wide, then hit into the gap.

games.summary: Singles from behind your baseline: a stick to move, a swipe to swing (direction aims, length = depth, speed = pace; lobs, slices, volleys); serves with a timing ring; first to 7 or games to 3; a ball machine for practice.

games.name: Metro Map

feed.hook: Draw the lines that get a growing city home.

games.summary: A city grows on a paper map: drag lines between stations, passengers ride to the shape they want and change lines on their own; limited lines, trains and bridges, a choice every week, and crowds that build slowly.

games.name: Bin Round

feed.hook: Hop off, empty the bins, wave to the neighbours.

games.summary: Ride on the back of a bin lorry along a calm street: tap a bin to fetch it, hold to empty it and let go in the green; recycling, garden waste and the odd armchair; residents wave, nothing can be lost.

games.name: Beach Watch

feed.hook: Spot the swimmer in trouble before anyone else does.

games.summary: Lifeguard on the tower: read the water, whistle drifters back, swim out to anyone in trouble and bring them in across the rip, flag the rips; miss two and the beach closes.

games.name: Hoops 3v3

feed.hook: Three on three: find the open shot.

games.summary: Three-a-side basketball played sideways: a stick and PASS / SHOOT / SPRINT, a shot meter with a moving green, layups and dunks, steals that can leave you off balance, a 12-second shot clock, and a three-game tournament.

games.name: Gridiron

feed.hook: Pick the play, read the coverage, go long.

games.summary: Five-a-side arcade American football, sideways: pick a play, SNAP, throw to a receiver's button or hand off and run; defend with SWITCH and TACKLE; replays of big plays.

games.name: Rock Climb

feed.hook: Pick your holds, mind your grip, top out.

games.summary: Calm one-thumb climbing, upright: drag a hand (later a foot) onto a hold that lights up; manage your grip, rest on ledges, read slopers and side-pulls, jump to far holds; the rope catches you at your last bolt.

games.name: Dentist

feed.hook: Clean, fill and fix: send them out smiling.

games.summary: Calm one-thumb dentist, upright: a 3D clinic and a 2D close-up of the mouth; brush, scrape and polish, find cavities with the mirror and X-ray, drill-rinse-fill-smooth-set, chips, crowns, braces, extractions; keep them comfortable; before-and-after smiles.

games.name: Balloon Drift

feed.hook: Steer by the winds: drop on the X, land soft.

games.summary: Mine: calm one-thumb hot air ballooning, upright: hold to burn, let go to sink, steer by climbing into the wind that goes your way; drop markers on the X, land near the field; wires, turning winds, warm air.

games.name: Sandworm Rider

feed.hook: Ride a giant worm through the dunes: surge, brace, breach.

games.summary: His idea 25: stand on the head of a giant worm swimming through the dunes. Left thumb steers (heavy, late turns), hold SURGE to speed up, hold BRACE for knocks and landings; keep your balance, breach over dune crests, pass every pair of waystones before sunset. Canyons, cracked sand, storms, ruins, three worms, shortcuts, a challenge per level, free roam.

games.name: Skydive

feed.hook: Jump, fly the freefall, open the canopy, land on the X.

games.summary: His idea 28: out of the plane into freefall (drag to fly, hold TUCK to dive), tap CHUTE between the yellow marks, fly the canopy down (turn, brakes) with the ring on the ground showing where you will land, hold FLARE for a soft landing on the X. Gold rings, ring courses, crosswinds that turn low down, islands, rooftops, a scenic mode.

games.name: Detective

feed.hook: Search the scene, question the suspects, prove who did it.

games.summary: His idea 33: generated cases (thefts, sabotage, fraud, disappearances, locked rooms) in a house, hotel, museum, train or office. Tap objects in the 3D room, turn them over to find hidden marks, question suspects and show them clues (liars crack, secret-keepers own up), link clues in the notebook, then accuse with who, how, when and two proving clues.

games.name: Convoy Escort

feed.hook: Command an escort: ping, hunt, depth-charge, bring the convoy home.

games.summary: His idea 34: command an escort ship guarding merchant ships to the harbour. Steer with a heavy wheel and a throttle; hydrophones and sonar pings show where submarines may be (rings that tighten when sure and grow when old); depth charges at shallow, medium or deep, the deck gun for surfaced boats; stay close and they will not fire; crew teams repair, fight fires and rescue. Night runs, rescues, a damaged ship, other escorts later.

planned.name: (my idea for set 19)
planned.summary: One of mine, to balance the set (picked when the set is built).

planned.name: Joust
planned.summary: his idea 26: charge on horseback, aim the lance, brace at contact, unseat rivals; tournaments.

planned.name: Splash Course
planned.summary: his idea 32: an obstacle course above water: giant balls, sweeper, punching wall, conveyor, rotating cross; funny falls.

planned.name: Surf
planned.summary: his idea 29: catch waves, carve, ride the barrel, tricks off the lip; balance and wipeouts.

planned.name: Santa's Round
planned.summary: his idea 31: fly the sleigh, land on roofs, sneak in, leave the right presents, do not wake anyone.

planned.name: (my idea for set 20)
planned.summary: One of mine, to balance the set (picked when the set is built).
